articles.title: Forget Pluto: This Tiny Kuiper Belt Object Has an Atmosphere, and It's Rewriting the Rules
articles.summary: A small icy rock just 310 miles wide, named 2002 XV93, has been found with its own atmosphere—a feat previously thought impossible for such a small body. Using a stellar occultation technique, astronomers detected gas bending starlight. The discovery, published in Nature Astronomy, challenges long-held ideas about where atmospheres can form.

articles.title: Sinner's Golden Sweep: At 24, He's Already Matched a Djokovic Milestone—and He's Just Getting Started
articles.summary: Jannik Sinner clinched the Italian Open, becoming only the second man ever to complete the 'career Golden Masters'—winning all nine ATP Masters 1000 titles. He achieved the feat at 24, seven years younger than Novak Djokovic. With four Grand Slams already, Sinner now sets his sights on the French Open and a career Grand Slam.

articles.title: We Tested 11 Automatic Cat Feeders: These Are the Ones That Actually Deliver
articles.summary: From AI-powered cameras to mini-fridges for wet food, automatic cat feeders have evolved far beyond simple gravity dispensers. WIRED's latest testing roundup highlights top picks like the Petkit YumShare Dual-Hopper 2 and the Petlibro Polar Smart Wet Feeder. These devices offer app control, portion management, and even whisker-friendly design—potentially transforming your cat's health and your sleep.
